decisions.decision: Airbnb-style multi-step listing wizard with draft-between-steps; publish requires full fields + >=3 photos + verified email; both hourly AND day rate required; first photo = cover, drag-reorder; Cloudinary signed direct uploads
decisions.rationale: Matches the Phase-1 Airbnb mimic; enforces the soft email-verification gate (D-07) at publish; keeps pricing comparable

decisions.decision: Fixed curated space types (primary type + activity tags) + curated amenities checklist; capacity = single max-occupancy integer; starter vocabulary locked (11 types / 15 tags / 13 amenities)
decisions.rationale: Clean Phase-4 search filters; capacity decision resolves the open 'group capacity source' decision and is the Phase-8 RSVP cap source

decisions.decision: Per-listing 'show exact address' toggle (default approximate, exact after booking); autocomplete -> store lat/lng now; map with approximate pin; no hard region geofence
decisions.rationale: Protects home-gym privacy while letting commercial venues show exact; coordinates captured now unblock Phase-4 radius search; soft region keeps the model region-capable

decisions.decision: Onboard Stripe anytime + persistent nudge (required only for bookability); published-but-unpayable = viewable with disabled CTA; live account.updated-driven bookability that auto-reverts on payout disable; one Connect account per host. Bookable <=> published AND email_verified AND payouts_enabled
decisions.rationale: Matches SC#1 (create/publish without onboarding) + SC#4 (bookable only when payouts enabled); the live gate can never be bypassed by later phases
